slots.idleBroker.body: {names} is Windows' idle Sandbox broker, left by {agent}'s last session in a Combwork that has since closed. No Sandbox is running, so releasing the slot is safe: Release Slot… frees it for other work, and the broker is left running.
slots.idleBroker.title: {slot} is held by {names}
slots.release.changed: {slot} changed meanwhile: its writer is no longer the one shown. Look again.
slots.release.live: {slot}'s writer is still running in this Combwork: stop the agent, or end or keep what it left running, first.
slots.release.notEnded: Some of the processes listed still run: Windows didn't let Combwork end them, so {slot} wasn't released. Try again, or release it without ending them.
slots.release.otherCombwork: {slot} is held by another Combwork that is still running (process {pid}): release it there, or quit that Combwork first.
slots.setting.bad: That isn’t a slot setting Combwork has.
slots.setting.badSize: The number of review and check copies is a whole number from {min, number} to {max, number}.
slots.setting.badSwitch: Set up submodules and LFS is on or off.
slots.setting.badText: A slot script or list of files is text of at most {max, number} characters.
